items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: when Paul Congelo we went to the electric bass. We had a lot of problems with bass players.

ctx.x: Did he prefer the electric bass?

Well you know I think when Joel DeBartolo and Ron Paley came on that when Paul Congelo we went to the electric bass. We had a lot of problems with bass players. There were times there when I was hiring and firing so many guys, and some really good guys, but you just couldn’t get the right guy. We got Joel DeBartolo finally, we got Joel on there for a long length of time. But there were just times when you couldn’t get a bass player that Buddy could agree with. I always felt, I’ve felt that Buddy always wanted…
Did you ever let a guy go that Buddy disagreed with? Like why did you let him go?
